answer: Mechanism: Enclave-Bound Nullifier Cipher. Each agent’s TEE derives a secret from its fused key and epoch beacon, encrypts a canonical fable/walnut payload into a unique cipher, and submits ciphertext plus attestation. A global nullifier set rejects duplicate ciphertexts or TEE identities. Copying another answer fails; minting another sybil requires another attested enclave. Attacker cost: one distinct secure enclave, attestation, and compute per identity, making mass creation hardware-bound and traceable.
